svg.text: Physical Nodes, Execution Environments, Artifact Topography & Network Communication Protocols
Legend: 📦 Solid Box Active Node | ╍ Dashed Box [Future Phase / Planned Module] | 📄 File Box Deployed Artifact | ──▶ HTTPS Network Line

g.text: Hardware: Desktop Workstation, Laptop, Mobile Smartphone
Google Chrome v115+, MS Edge, Mozilla Firefox, Apple Safari
• Built Assets: HTML5, JavaScript ES6+, CSS3 (Tailwind)
• Client-Side State: React Hooks, Context API, LocalStorage (JWT Token)
• Target Modules: Login, Register, Catalog, Booking UI
Captures email/password, dispatches auth requests, stores JWT
Fetches machinery list, category filters, handles multipart file forms
Calculates daily rental cost totals, date range picker, reservation submit
Role-based management views for equipment owners & renters
Razorpay SDK integration, payment gateway popups (Planned)
🔔 Notification Bell Drawer [Future Phase / Planned Module]
In-app alert drawer for booking approvals (Planned)
⭐ Review & Rating Widget [Future Phase / Planned Module]
OS: Linux Ubuntu Server 22.04 LTS / AWS EC2 / Local Host Node
«execution environment» Node.js Runtime Engine (v18.x+) & Express Framework [Active]
⚡ Future Controllers & Integration Services [Future Phase / Planned Module]
«external device» Razorpay Payment Gateway Server [Future Phase / Planned Module]
• Protocols: HTTPS REST API / JSON Payload, Webhook Signatures
• Payment Methods: UPI (Google Pay, PhonePe), Credit/Debit Cards, NetBanking
• Escrow Logic: Holds funds until booking status changes to 'completed'
• Webhook Callbacks: Automatic payment verification & order status sync
• Security: PCI-DSS Compliant, SHA-256 Signature Hash Verification
«external device» SMTP / SendGrid Email Gateway Server [Future Phase / Planned Module]
Provider: SendGrid API / Nodemailer SMTP Gateway
• Booking Alerts: Email alerts sent to owners upon new rental request
• Confirmation Notices: Approval email dispatch to farmers with PDF receipts
• Account Verification: Password reset tokens & email verification links
• Security: TLS 1.3 / DKIM / SPF Domain Verification
• Version Control: Main branch production builds, feature branch pull requests
• CI Automation: GitHub Actions workflows for automated code testing
• Deployment Triggers: Automated webhook triggers to production cloud instance
• Documentation Host: Central repository for all architecture markdown files & diagrams
